name: Otoroe Shirazu no Inran Baa-chan! ~Mago no Nikubou mo Itadakimasu♪~
original_name: 衰え知らずの淫乱ばあちゃん！ ～孫の肉棒もいただきます♪～
source:
Yawai Emi is taking care of her three grandchildren, whom she raised as her own. She helps them financially and takes care of all the household chores.

She was particularly uninterested in raising her three grandchildren because her daughter Ema did not want to raise them herself. It was common for her to leave her young children with her and go out at night.

Her daughter became even more uninhibited since her husband passed away, and has started to prioritize herself even more. Fortunately her grandchildren cooperate with each other and support one another.

Then one day... By chance, Emi finds a piece of tissue that smells like semen in the trash bin. At that moment, a thought occured to her. "They're men, and there are things only I can do for them."

This, Emi begins to reward her grandchildren for their hard work.

[From [url=https://www.appetite-game.com/apt_218.html#story]official site[/url]]
translation:
矢井惠美正在照顾她的三个孙子，她把他们当作自己的孩子抚养长大。她在经济上帮助他们并照顾所有的家务。

她对抚养三个孙子特别不感兴趣，因为她的女儿艾玛不想自己抚养他们。她把年幼的孩子留在身边，晚上出去是很平常的事。

自从丈夫去世后，女儿变得更加不羁，更加以自己为重。幸运的是，她的孙子们互相配合、互相支持。

然后有一天……惠美偶然在垃圾桶里发现了一块闻起来像精液的纸巾。就在这时，她心里生出了一个念头。“他们是男人，有些事情只有我能为他们做。”

惠美开始奖励孙子们的辛勤工作。

[来自[url=https://www.appetite-game.com/apt_218.html#story]官方网站[/url]]
